target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07) / macOS (arm64 and x86_64 builds)
scope: playback-core-v1 partial requirement clauses only (see spec.md)
fixture_origin: Independently generated minimal Live Sets and two generated 16-bit WAV files; no shipped file content
oracle_status: Extracted-execution arithmetic and static-derived expectations (label per case); neither the reference application nor a candidate executed

representation.input: Live Set file (gzip); samples: WAV files it references, relative to the set's folder
representation.script: actions in order, each handled at render sample `at`: play (start_beat), stop, continue, launch (track, slot; transport stopped: start_beat); see spec.md
representation.midi: window [from, to) of render samples; events: samples (one value, or two: either is accepted), type note-on or note-off, key, velocity (binary32 value, compared after exact widening)
representation.audio: windows: from (first render sample) and values (one per consecutive sample, both channels); tolerance exact, relative (|a - e| <= value * |e|) or absolute (|a - e| <= value)
representation.informative: derived quantities shown for understanding; not compared
representation.note: project comparison representation, not an API of the original application or a required design
